abstract.para: The installation overview shows the most relevant settings. Each category displays a summary of its settings. Categories with invalid settings are marked. Configure them before you start the installation.

textobject.phrase: Screenshot of the &agama; installer for &productname; &productnumber; showing the initial installation settings overview. It summarizes system information and flags pending or invalid settings that must be resolved before proceeding.

topic.para: Select a category to adjust its settings.

There is no particular order for the configuration, but it is recommended to start with the System settings and continue with the Registration. Categories with pending or invalid settings must be resolved before proceeding with the installation.
